summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-L6 admits no external crate. academic-next-lecture links academic-domain, academic-gap, academic-ingestion, academic-lecture-document, academic-untrusted-content, serde and thiserror as product edges, and academic-capture, academic-consent, academic-domain, academic-freshness, academic-home, academic-knowledge-state, academic-model-run, academic-policy, academic-repository, academic-repository-analysis, academic-repository-classification, academic-repository-correlation, academic-transcription, serde_json, tempfile, trybuild and uuid as dev edges, all covered by earlier reviewed receipts, and adds one workspace path package. Nothing links into a product binary that was not already there: the five workspace product edges are path packages this repository already builds, and serde and thiserror were admitted by the phase 1 receipt. Build-time-only additions are zero -- there is no build script, no proc macro beyond serde's and thiserror's, and no code generator.
summary.added_workspace_path_package_note: academic-next-lecture is the P2-L6 boundary: section 12.7's seven places an ExpectedConceptClaim is extracted from, the candidate standing every one of them keeps, the minimality contract that excludes a full preview and an advanced survey, and the three-way uncertainty factorization section 12.7's last sentence requires. It is a separate package from academic-gap because the restraint section 12.7 demands is then a graph fact rather than a rule: nothing here can produce a preparation candidate without a GapCase that crate's own search produced, and nothing in that crate can produce a claim about tomorrow's lecture. It is a separate package from academic-home because the morning card's 1-3 bound is then a comparison between two crates rather than one crate reading its own constant twice: academic-home is a dev edge and morning_home_contract compares LOWEST_PREPARATION and HIGHEST_PREPARATION against P2-X2's LOWEST_BRIEF and HIGHEST_BRIEF after parsing both bounds out of the design document.

no_second_ladder_note: Section 12.7's seven places, section 12.7's last sentence's three axes and section 12.7's `not included` line are each measured against PERSONAL_ACADEMIC_CS_PROJECT_OS_END_STATE_DESIGN.md in both directions rather than restated as numbers here: expected_concept_source_matrix and prep_uncertainty_factorization each split the document's own sentence on its own commas, compare the cells with EXPECTED_CONCEPT_SOURCES and PREP_AXES in order and as sets, then remove every matched cell and require what is left to be separators, so an eighth place or a fourth axis leaves text behind and fails rather than being folded into the nearest arm. `다음 title/slide` is one cell and not two, and the removal pass is what executes that reading. Section 15.2's five gap kinds and its `강한 부족` were fixed by P2-N5 and this crate declares no second enumeration: MinimalityDefect::NotALikelyBlock is RootCandidate::is_strong_deficit answering false, so `이해를 막을 가능성이 큰` is that crate's own reading of section 15.2's table rather than a threshold here. P2-C4's twenty predicates and the two a path engine may traverse are the domain registry's and this crate holds no allowlist: MinimalityDefect::BeyondTheExpectedConcept is a breadth-first walk over PrerequisiteGraph::blocking_out_of, which is the same admission P2-N5's own expand runs. EntityKind's five ontology tiers were fixed by P2-C3 and gap_bearing is P2-N5's total match over them, so a claim naming a whole FIELD is refused in that crate's own words rather than by a list here. EpistemicStatus's nine values were fixed by P2-C1 and this crate produces exactly one of them, AiInferred, with no constructor parameter by which another could be reached. Section 4's `선수개념 1-3개` and section 25.2's `최대 1-3개` are parsed independently, required to agree with each other, and then compared with P2-X2's own constants, so the morning card has one bound across two crates and the agreement is executed. Two refusals this crate deliberately does not make are cited rather than re-checked: GapExplanation::of already refuses an unbounded or uncited remediation before a RootCandidate exists, and P2-G5's proposal schema already refuses an output with no support line, so a branch here for either would be one no input reaches -- which is what P2-R5 measured as a suite that cannot see a real defect.

direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-domain: ConfidencePermille, EntityId, EpistemicStatus, EvidenceId, FreshnessBand, MasteryLevel, entity_registry::EntityKind and predicates::{PredicateName, PrerequisiteStrength}. EpistemicStatus::AiInferred is section 27.4's own spelling for a low-risk extracted topic, and it is an associated constant here rather than a constructor parameter, which is the whole of the candidate contract: there is no argument a caller could pass to get another value. EntityKind is what refuses a FIELD as an expected concept, in P2-C3's own words.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-gap: BlockingPath, ConceptState, GapCase, GapKind, MinimumRemediation, PrerequisiteEdge, PrerequisiteGraph, RootCandidate and gap_bearing. Section 12.7's `이것을 Knowledge State와 prerequisite graph에 비교해` is that crate's descent, so propose takes a GapCase and computes no deficit of its own. What the edge brings that a ready-made list would not is the point: a preparation candidate is assembled from a RootCandidate that P2-N5's own search produced, its `왜 지금` is that candidate's BlockingPath with a strength on every hop, and its `예상 시간` is that candidate's own bounded 최소 보강. There is no function in this crate that produces a RootCandidate, so a candidate this crate could offer without a real descent is a value that does not exist.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-ingestion: dating::Date. Section 27.1's confirmation condition for the next-lecture-prerequisite row is `자료 날짜·state·edge 불확실성 노출`, so every material carries a validated calendar date rather than a string and 2026-02-30 is a value that does not exist. It is P2-U6's valid-time type, and CONTRIBUTING.md's third rule keeps that axis apart from the retrieval clock and from ingest order; this crate names neither of the other two.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-lecture-document: NodeId. Section 12.7's seventh place is `직전 강의 말미`, and it is a node of a P2-L4 lossless document rather than a quotation. MaterialReference::of requires that node for that place and refuses it for the other six, so the one source that came from inside this system cites the artifact that preserved it, and the six that came from outside cannot claim a preservation that never happened. The crate is already in this crate's closure through academic-gap by way of academic-knowledge-state; declaring it directly adds nothing to the closure and makes the citation type honest.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-untrusted-content: Proposal, ResolvedSpan and SourceId. Section 12.7's places are all text somebody outside this system wrote, so ExpectedConceptClaim::extract takes a Proposal -- the value only adjudicate produces -- and copies its resolved spans. Untrusted::expose is pub(crate) in that crate, so no product file here can read one ingested byte: a claim carries a source identity, a byte range and a digest and cannot carry the material's words. The role vocabulary and the document vocabulary are deliberately not mapped onto each other -- seven places against six SourceKinds -- and they are bound at the one point where a mismatch would matter: a claim whose declared material is not among the spans the model cited is refused.

dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-capture: P2-L2's begin, its journal and its preflight readings, reached through P2-N5's fixture module and P2-N2's beneath it, so the document a claim's exposure evidence rests on is built over the file the real capture surface wrote.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-consent: P2-L2's consent ledger, capture request and permission scope, because a capture that is not permitted writes no journal and the fixture must pass the same gate a real one does.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-domain: Declared a second time for the trybuild reason academic-scenario gives: a compile-fail case compiles against this crate plus its dev-dependencies, and one case names a ConfidencePermille.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-freshness: FreshnessProjection and project. Every band a ConceptReading carries is produced by P2-N3's own projection and then verified against what the fixture meant, so a fixture that stops producing what it says it produces fails at the fixture rather than making a later assertion vacuous.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-home: LOWEST_BRIEF and HIGHEST_BRIEF. P2-X2 offers the same morning card, and morning_home_contract parses section 4's `선수개념 1-3개` and section 25.2's `최대 1-3개` independently, requires the two readings to agree, and then compares them with both crates' constants. A dev edge rather than a product one on purpose: the claim is that two crates cannot drift apart, and a product edge would make one crate's bound the other's by construction rather than by comparison.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-knowledge-state: EligibilityOutcome and the fixture module beneath P2-N5's. Mastery evidence goes through P2-N2's own four eligibility checks; nothing in this suite asserts a rung into existence. It is a dev edge and there is no product edge of any kind, which is what an_extracted_claim_is_never_confirmed reads out of the public signatures: no function here returns a type that crate reads.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-model-run: CalibrationRegistry and its dataset types, which P2-L3's confidence interpretation requires before a transcript segment exists.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-policy: ContentDigest, for the analysis policy hash a P2-R1 snapshot request carries inside the shared fixture module.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository: P2-R1's capture_local and SnapshotRequest, reached through the shared fixture module.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-analysis: P2-R2's EvidenceLadder and Finding, reached through the same module.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-classification: P2-R4's ConceptStance, which that module reads.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-correlation: P2-R3's correlate, the only route from findings to the relation edges P2-R4 reads.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-transcription: P2-L3's run, its provider contract and its transcript lineage, so a document node maps a segment of a real transcript.
dev_workspace_dependencies.serde_json: Reserved by the shared fixture module's chain; no assertion in this suite encodes a preparation, because section 12.7 fixes no wire shape for one.
dev_workspace_dependencies.tempfile: The directory a P2-L2 journal is written to. It is a dev edge only; no product file of this crate names it or any other filesystem type.
dev_workspace_dependencies.trybuild: The compile-fail suite. Section 12.7's limits are types, and the four cases under crates/next-lecture/tests/compile_fail assert that each refusal is a program that does not compile with a committed diagnostic. The cases live in this package rather than in academic-scenario's suite for the reason P2-N2 and P2-N5 give: this crate reaches academic-knowledge-state through academic-gap, which reaches academic-ledger, and scenario_crate_has_no_writer_dependency refuses academic-scenario that crate through a dev edge as much as a product one.
dev_workspace_dependencies.uuid: Deterministic UUIDv7-shaped fixture identities. Every identifier in the suite is a SHA-256 of the fixture's own name with the version and variant nibbles set, so no identity is a function of a clock.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: academic-next-lecture is a workspace path crate, not an external dependency. It owns section 12.7's next-lecture preparation and, for each rule, the value that does not exist rather than the check somebody has to remember to run: ExpectedConceptClaim::extract takes no epistemic status, so an extracted claim that is anything other than AI_INFERRED has no argument to be built from; it takes a P2-G5 Proposal, which only adjudicate produces, so a claim over unadjudicated bytes has no constructor; MaterialReference::of pairs section 12.7's seventh place with a P2-L4 node in both directions, so a syllabus claiming a preservation and a lecture ending claiming none are both values that cannot be written; PrepUncertainty holds three readings of three different types with no trait between them and no method that answers with a confidence, so folding the three axes into one number has no operation to be folded by; PreparationBrief::assemble takes the whole candidate list and there is no push, so a fourth foundation cannot be added after the 1-3 bound was checked; and propose answers TooManyBlockingFoundations with the count rather than choosing three, which is section 25.2's own `알림 수가 많으면 자동 중요도 순으로 숨기지 않고`. Its dependency set is minimal and the edges it does not have are the point: no academic-knowledge-state, so no function here produces the evidence a mastery promotion is read from; no academic-store, so no preparation reaches the canonical writer and no migration is added; no academic-worker and no academic-egress-boundary, so nothing in its closure can launch a process or stage a payload.
network_posture: The crate opens no socket, opens no file, reads no clock, declares no foreign function, reads no environment variable, spawns no process, and runs no build script. It spells no std::fs, std::net, std::process, std::env or std::time name at all: every date arrives inside a P2-U6 value and every band inside a P2-N3 one. no_clock_socket_or_file_reaches_this_crate and the_public_surface_is_inventoried in crates/next-lecture/tests/next_lecture_scans.rs compare the whole set of its 34 use items, the whole set of the 7 two-segment paths it reaches through a crate root, the whole set of the 1 macro it invokes, the whole set of its 11 impl headers and the whole set of its public signatures with the type each sits on against pinned inventories in both directions, and run a whole-identifier pass for fifteen filesystem, clock, process and transport constructs over every product file. the_next_lecture_crate_holds_no_phrase_list compares the whole set of non-ASCII string literals in the package against the design document -- each must occur in it verbatim -- and the whole set of every method any product file calls against a pinned inventory, which is the half that refuses an English-language phrase list: such a list is ASCII and could only be used through a text comparison, and a text comparison is a method the inventory does not hold. Seventeen injections that spell none of the forbidden tokens were each compiled alone, each observed passing clippy, and each observed failing a named test: an eighth extraction place, a single confidence over the three axes, a From impl that declares no pub, the direction of the advancement question reversed, a Korean phrase list in the shape somebody would actually write one, the morning bound widened by one, the material binding dropped, the document-node rule dropped in each direction, the overlay/candidate agreement deleted, the case/claim agreement deleted, the refusal to rank replaced by a truncation, the edge/state agreement deleted, the repetition rule deleted, the likelihood rule deleted, the reachability rule deleted, and the tier rule deleted. Two further deletions were found to be masked and both were repaired: the edge/state agreement was reachable but untested, and a direct case now drives PrepUncertainty::factor rather than only the candidate constructor above it; the citation-count refusal was unreachable, because P2-G5's schema requires a support line, and it was removed rather than tested. Every document, capture, transcript, snapshot, proposal, claim and projection in its test tree is synthetic and built in process; no real lecture or material is read and no network call is made.
advisory_path: Unchanged. Every external crate academic-next-lecture links was admitted by an earlier receipt and is triaged through that receipt's advisory path. serde and thiserror were admitted by the phase 1 receipt; serde_json, tempfile, trybuild and uuid are already-admitted dev dependencies of other workspace packages. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request.
